title: jmap-server: /query and /queryChanges with language (localized sort/filter, queryState, cannotCalculateChanges)
description:
jmap-server: /query and /queryChanges with `language`.
- Sort and filter on a localizable property compare the value /get would return for that `language`, not the base value. This needs the backend query hook to receive the language (decision .1(c)). Memory backends do it.
- When the Comparator has no collation, the backend MAY pick one for the chosen language. Default: keep the current collation.
- queryState encodes the language (decision .1(d)). When the /queryChanges `language` differs from the one in sinceQueryState: cannotCalculateChanges.
Tests: sorting Mailboxes by localized name; a language mismatch on queryChanges.
